item.title: Rochester Man Sentenced to 54 Months for Unlawful Possession of a Firearm
item.description: Travis Frazier, 28, Rochester, Indiana, was sentenced by United States District Court Judge Cristal C. Brisco after pleading guilty to possessing a firearm as a convicted felon and possessing a firearm after having been convicted of a misdemeanor crime of domestic violence, announced Acting United States Attorney M. Scott Proctor.

item.title: LaGrange County Community Foundation Awards $110K In Community Impact Grants
item.description: 10 local nonprofits will expand their work - from health therapy to electrical education - through $110,000 in Community Impact Grants awarded this fall by the LaGrange County Community Foundation.

item.title: Warming Centers Around Kosciusko County
item.description: With the temperatures set to plummet over the next several days, places in the area are acting as warming centers, allowing the public to come in and warm themselves during the projected hazardous weather.

item.title: Recorder’s Office Combating Home Title Theft
item.description: Kosciusko County is making efforts to combat the ongoing threat of home title theft, which has become a crime of particular concern to the Kosciusko County Recorder’s Office.

item.title: Concern Over SB1 Hampers Syracuse Town Council’s Work Session
item.description: A work session to discuss capital improvement projects was hampered as members of the Syracuse Town Council expressed concern over how Senate Bill 1 will affect the town’s finances in the future.

item.title: Pilot Program Allowing State Workers To Bring Newborns To Work
item.description: Indiana will begin allowing some state employees to bring their infants to work under a pilot program announced Tuesday, Dec. 2 by Gov. Mike Braun and detailed in a newly issued policy.
